about: Reusable cartoon-explainer effects. generate_asset.py --library NAME renders one into the shared cache once (AGENT_AUDIO_LIBRARY, default <skill>/library/) and every film reuses it. Prompts describe source, action, material, count and tail; keep one event per effect so it lands on a frame.

whoosh-soft.prompt: One soft airy cartoon whoosh passing left to right, smooth swell and quick fade, no impact.

whoosh-fast.prompt: One fast sharp whip-pan whoosh, bright air swish, very short tail.

whoosh-swirl.prompt: One spinning swirl whoosh that circles around and fades, playful cartoon motion.

punch-whoosh-hit.prompt: A quick rising whoosh that ends in one punchy low cartoon impact hit, tight tail.

flash-hit.prompt: A bright camera-flash zap followed by one short cinematic hit, crisp and dry.

ink-splat-whoosh.prompt: A wet ink splash whoosh, liquid splat spreading across paper, short and clean.

projector-flicker.prompt: Old 1920s film projector starting up, mechanical clatter and flicker for one second, then stops.

shimmer-swell.prompt: A soft magical shimmer swell, glassy chimes rising then fading, gentle.

impact-hit.prompt: One punchy cinematic impact hit with a low thump and short boom tail, dry, no music.

impact-heavy.prompt: One heavy cartoon impact, iron weight slamming onto a wooden floor, deep thud with brief rattle.

rumble-hit.prompt: One short ground rumble with a low boom, objects rattling briefly, then settles.

stamp-thud.prompt: One rubber office stamp slammed hard onto paper on a wooden desk, firm thud, tiny paper rattle.

title-hit.prompt: A short whoosh into one bold cinematic title hit with a low boom and bright metallic ring tail.

card-slam.prompt: A thick cardboard sign slapped down onto a table, one flat slam with paper flutter.

explosion-cartoon.prompt: One cartoon explosion, punchy boom with debris tinkle, short and not too long.

glitch-static.prompt: A short digital glitch: stuttering electronic static burst and buzz, abrupt stop.

boom-whoosh.prompt: A shockwave: low boom with a wide whoosh expanding outward, fast decay.

poof.prompt: One cartoon smoke poof, soft puff of air with a light sparkle, quick.

splat.prompt: One wet cartoon splat, a blob hitting a wall, squishy and short.

party-pop.prompt: A party popper bang followed by light confetti rustle, celebratory.

typewriter-ding.prompt: Three quick vintage typewriter key strikes then one carriage bell ding.

counter-ticks.prompt: A mechanical counter rolling fast: rapid light clicks for two seconds ending in one soft ding.

map-pin-pop.prompt: A small pin dropping onto a paper map, one soft pop with a tiny tap.

camera-flash.prompt: One 1920s magnesium flashbulb camera: shutter click and a short bright pop-fizz.

gas-hiss.prompt: Toxic gas escaping from a valve, a steady hiss that swells then fades.

paper-flutter.prompt: A burst of loose paper sheets fluttering through the air, rustle that settles.

sparkle-chime.prompt: A bright sparkle chime, a few glassy twinkles, light and magical.

dark-swell.prompt: A low dark ominous swell, deep drone rising for two seconds then cut, no melody.

camera-servo.prompt: A security camera motor turning with a small servo whir and click.

spotlight-click.prompt: A heavy theatre spotlight switching on: one loud clunk then a faint electrical hum.

wing-flaps.prompt: A few birds taking off, quick wing flaps fading away.

footstep-scuff.prompt: One shoe scuff skid on a dusty floor, short.

comic-drip.prompt: Cartoon sweat drop, a tiny water drip plink.

cartoon-drop-thud.prompt: A cartoon object dropping onto the floor with a squashy bouncy thud.

pop.prompt: One small clean cartoon pop, like a cork, very short.

comic-boing.prompt: One cartoon boing spring sound, quick wobble, comedic.

record-scratch.prompt: One vinyl record scratch stop, sharp and comedic.

sinister-sting.prompt: A short sinister sting: low bass hit with a creepy metallic shimmer, villain reveal.

ui-click.prompt: One crisp soft interface click, clean and short.

ding.prompt: One bright bell ding, like a correct-answer chime, short ring.

cash-register.prompt: Vintage cash register cha-ching: drawer slides open with a bell ring and coin clink.

slide-whistle-down.prompt: A descending cartoon slide whistle, falling pitch, comedic.

error-buzzer.prompt: A harsh game-show wrong-answer buzzer, short.

heartbeat.prompt: Two slow heavy heartbeats, deep and close, tense.

clock-tick.prompt: A mechanical clock ticking four times, dry and close.

bulb-blowout.prompt: A small incandescent light bulb blowing out: one sharp glass tink and a short electric pop, close, dry, no reverb.

pen-scratch.prompt: A fountain pen scratching a short line of handwriting on thick paper, close and dry.

phone-bell-1920s.prompt: One short burst of an old 1920s mechanical telephone bell ringing, metallic, in a quiet office.

knife-switch-lever.prompt: A big electrical knife switch lever thrown with a heavy metal clunk, then a quick rising electric hum.

gavel-strike.prompt: One sharp wooden judge's gavel strike on a sound block in a courtroom, short wooden crack with a small room reflection.

toaster-pop-die.prompt: A chrome toaster popping up toast with a spring clang, then a tiny electrical fizz and crackle as it dies.

amb-night-room-hum.prompt: Quiet room tone of an old fire station at night: a low steady electrical hum of a single incandescent light bulb, faint distant traffic outside. Steady background bed, no voices.

amb-rain-window.prompt: Steady rain on a window glass at night with soft gutter drips and very distant thunder. Steady background bed, no voices.

amb-lab-bulbs-buzz.prompt: Many incandescent test light bulbs buzzing together in a tiled laboratory, steady electrical hum with a faint wall clock ticking. Steady background bed, no voices.

amb-factory-1920s.prompt: 1920s factory floor: rhythmic metal clanking machinery, steam hiss and a rattling conveyor belt. Steady background bed, no voices.
